instrument_option_fields.name: instrument_option_fields
instrument_option_fields.value: ("instrument"."asset_class" = 'option') = ("instrument"."expiry" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."strike" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."option_right" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."underlying_id" IS NOT NULL)

instrument_future_fields.name: instrument_future_fields
instrument_future_fields.value: "instrument"."asset_class" <> 'future' OR ("instrument"."future_root" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."contract_month" IS NOT NULL AND "instrument"."expiry" IS NOT NULL)
